Briefly explain why bread dough rises while yeast is active. Use a single paragraph of plain accurate prose. Write approximately 32–40 English tokens. Return only the text.

message.content: Yeast consumes sugars within the dough, producing carbon dioxide gas as a metabolic byproduct. This gas becomes trapped inside the elastic gluten network, causing the dough to expand and rise significantly during the fermentation process known as proofing.
